items.t: Automatic slips and the O/D light flashes
items.note: Owners report about $1,700-$3,400 total. A used transmission can cost less.

items.t: Automatic transmission fails on 2007-2010 trucks
items.note: Owners report about $2,000-$4,700. Torque converter and solenoid damage add to the bill.

items.t: Timing chain rattle or failure
items.job: Replace timing chains, guides and tensioners
items.note: The rear chain on this engine may require pulling the engine, which raises labor. Owners report about $2,000-$3,000.

items.t: Harsh, delayed or slamming shifts
items.job: Reprogram transmission computer; replace solenoid pack if needed
items.note: Reprogramming alone was quoted around $270; a solenoid pack repair about $1,500.

items.t: No-crank or stalling from chafed engine computer wiring
items.job: Repair chafed engine harness at PCM bracket

items.t: Hard starting, rough idle or idle dips when slowing
Spark plugs break off during removal
items.job: Replace spark plugs with broken-plug extraction
items.note: If plug pieces fall into a cylinder, head removal can push the bill to about $3,000.

items.t: Crankshaft pulley rubber separates
items.job: Replace crankshaft pulley (harmonic balancer) and drive belt
items.note: Owners report about $220-$480.

items.t: Radiator cracks at the plastic top tank
items.note: Owners report about $300 (aftermarket) to $1,300 (dealer).

items.t: Plastic thermostat housing cracks and leaks
items.note: Owners report $150-$200.

items.t: Cab-to-frame body mounts crumble
items.note: One owner was quoted $500.

items.t: Paint cracking or peeling on hood and cab
items.note: Owners report about $1,300 for hood and cab; a full repaint costs more.

items.t: Four-wheel drive will not engage
items.note: A dealer quoted about $500. Sometimes cleaning a corroded connector fixes it.

items.t: Front lower ball joints wear out
items.note: Add an alignment afterward.

items.t: Gauges and instrument cluster cut out
items.note: Owners report about $850-$950 installed.

items.t: Oil seepage at the rear axle shaft seals
Front brake rotors and calipers wear out early
items.job: Replace front brake calipers, pads and rotors

items.t: Passenger airbag sensor fails
items.note: A dealer quoted about $850.

items.t: Water leaks into the rear cab area
items.job: Reseal or replace rear lamp assembly
